description: Read what went wrong while this account was getting its data into Spark: imports that failed or were never finished, integrations whose sign-in stopped working, failed history backfills, failed or blocked migrations, and connects started from chat that never finished. Call it when get_onboarding_state returns an issues block, or when the person asks why their data isn't showing. Each issue has a title and what it means in the person's terms, the first errors an import recorded, and exactly one fix: fix.action call_tool means call fix.tool with fix.arguments (when fix.opensUrlField is set, hand the person the link in that field of the result); ask_assistant means work it through with the person, starting with fix.tool. Lead with the first issue's fix. Issues cannot be dismissed: each clears on its own within about 15 minutes of being fixed. Account-wide: a client-pinned credential gets none.
name: get_onboarding_issues
title: Onboarding Issues
